title: RISK_OFF stress recalibration block (Z2, 2026-07-15)
description: Validation schema for the additive regime_stress block in config/env.yaml. Source of truth for the credit + vix ratio-z stress parameters; code defaults mirror these and are asserted equal by tests/test_regime_stress_config_parity.py. Updated atomically with the YAML.

z_window.description: Trailing sessions for the rolling z baseline.

min_sessions.description: Below this a component is INCOMPUTABLE (excluded from the composite), never silently 0-stress.

z_full_scale.description: z at which a component saturates to stress 1.0.

backwardation_z.description: VIXY/VIXM ratio z above which vix_backwardation latches True.

weights.description: Base composite weights; renormalized over the COMPUTABLE components at evaluation time.
